inputs.prompt: A wide cinematic film still of a small, calm, tasteful modern bedroom at night, seen from a locked camera at chest height, looking straight at the back wall. On the left, the man from image 1 and image 2 lies asleep on his back in a low bed, his head on a pillow at the left end of the bed, his face turned a little toward the camera, eyes closed, peaceful. A soft off-white duvet covers him up to his chest and one arm rests on top of it. He wears the same plain dark charcoal T-shirt. His face, hair, beard and skin tone are exactly as in image 1. The wall behind the bed is plain and dark. In the middle of the back wall, a tall window with thin curtains lets in cool blue moonlight that falls in a soft pool across the open wooden floor between the bed and the desk. On the right, a small wooden desk with a closed laptop on it and a simple wooden chair stand in shadow. A small bedside lamp beside the pillow glows warm and low, so his face and shoulder are lit warm. The rest of the room is deep teal-ink shadow, a dark blue-green. He is the only person in the room. The whole bed, the window and the whole desk are inside the frame, with room above the bed. Photorealistic, like a frame from a premium advertising film shot on a cinema camera with a 28mm lens: deep shadows, gentle film grain, natural colours. Nothing written anywhere, no clock, no posters, no pictures on the walls.

expect.unit: USD (the endpoint bills in units of 1 dollar, by tokens)
expect.basis: 2K pictures of this package were billed $0.062 to $0.069 each; two pictures, high thinking
